items.name: component-alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog that asks the user to confirm a destructive action.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: AppShell is the page shell for an application. It provides slots for top navigation, side navigation, banners, and main content. Use it as the root wrapper for every page. It handles responsive mobile navigation and skip-to-content automatically. Configure side nav collapse on SideNav with its collapsible prop.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Maintains a fixed width-to-height ratio for its children as its container resizes. Use it for media containers like videos, images, thumbnails, or any content that needs consistent proportions. It takes its width from the container and derives its height from the ratio, so it needs an ancestor with a definite width.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Displays a user avatar with image, initials fallback, and optional status indicator.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: Stacked avatar display with overlapping layout and optional overflow indicator. Children are Avatar elements.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-avatar-group-overflow
items.title: Avatar Group Overflow
items.description: Overflow indicator for AvatarGroup. Shows a compact count for hidden avatars and can render custom count text or act as a button.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-avatar-status-dot
items.title: Avatar Status Dot
items.description: Size-aware status indicator dot that reads avatar size from context and scales proportionally. Each variant pairs a colour with a distinct built-in shape (filled, ring, minus) so status is never conveyed by colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Badge highlights a status or category at a glance. Use it sparingly: only when a value represents a distinct state (Active, Failed) or a grouping tag (Engineering, Design). Most metadata (dates, durations, counts, descriptions) should be plain description text, not badges.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Banner shows a persistent message at the top of a page or section. Use it for form errors, system updates, maintenance notices, or success confirmations that the user needs to see until they act on it.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-base-typeahead
items.title: Base Typeahead
items.description: Composable combobox engine providing a bare input, search, keyboard navigation, and a styled result dropdown. It renders no input wrapper, border, or selected-value token. Typeahead and Tokenizer compose it for standard fields.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-blockquote
items.title: Blockquote
items.description: A quotation block with a rule on its inline-start edge and secondary text color. Use to highlight quoted content, testimonials, or excerpts. The rule and padding are logical, so they move to the right edge in right-to-left locales.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom Sheet
items.description: A mobile touch surface for filters, actions, forms, and detail views that should rise from the bottom of the viewport; use BottomSheetSwitcher for multi-step flows.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-bottom-sheet-switcher
items.title: Bottom Sheet Switcher
items.description: Coordinates a multi-step bottom-sheet flow in one shared dialog; set activeSheet to a nested BottomSheet's sheetId to open or switch steps, and to null to close.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-breadcrumb-item
items.title: Breadcrumb Item
items.description: Individual breadcrumb item that renders as a link when href is provided, or as plain text for the current page.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Navigation container that renders a <nav> with an ordered list of breadcrumb items.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button triggers an action when clicked. Use it for form submissions, confirmations, navigation, or any interaction that needs a clear call to action.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Groups multiple buttons together with connected styling: shared borders, proper border-radius handling (only on outer edges), and horizontal or vertical orientation.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Calendar lets the user pick a date or date range from a month grid. Use it in booking flows, scheduling UIs, date filters, or anywhere the user needs to see surrounding dates for context.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card is a bordered, elevated container for discrete, self-contained items: things you could reorder, remove, or interact with independently. Cards are NOT the default layout tool. Most content groups don't need a container at all; spacing and alignment create visual grouping naturally. Only reach for a Card when items need clear interaction boundaries or visual comparison in a grid.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Carousel scrolls a row of items horizontally when they overflow the available width. Use it for card grids, image galleries, product lists, or any set of items that should be browsable without taking up the full page.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-center
items.title: Center
items.description: Center aligns content to the middle of its container. Use it for empty states, loading screens, login forms, or any content that should sit in the center of the available space.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-composer
items.title: Chat Composer
items.description: Layout shell for a chat composer. Arranges named slots (drawer, header, input, footer, send) with page-radius container, elevation, a keyboard-only editor focus ring, and concentric inner radius for child elements.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-composer-drawer
items.title: Chat Composer Drawer
items.description: Collapsible drawer panel that sits above the chat input inside ChatComposer. Pass it to the composer's `drawer` slot to show attachments, context chips, or any supplementary content. When `count` is provided the drawer gains a collapse toggle: collapsed state shows the default Badge and label or caller-provided `collapsedSummary`, while expanded state shows all children.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-composer-input
items.title: Chat Composer Input
items.description: Rich text input for the chat composer. Supports trigger menus (type @ or / to open a typeahead), inline tokens rendered as badges, message history recall with ArrowUp/Down, paste/drop file handling, and a 16px iOS font-size floor to prevent input zoom. Pass it to ChatComposer's input slot when you need more than a plain textarea.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-composer-token-element
items.title: Chat Composer Token Element
items.description: Renders a single token chip outside the contentEditable input. Wraps a badge config or custom render function in the correct data-astryx-token span so the token serializes properly and stays visually consistent with tokens inside the composer.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-dictation-button
items.title: Chat Dictation Button
items.description: ChatDictationButton is a toggle button that starts and stops voice dictation inside a chat composer. It pairs with useChatDictation to show a microphone icon when idle and animated frequency bars when listening. Place it in the sendActions slot of ChatComposer.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-layout
items.title: Chat Layout
items.description: Layout shell for full chat interfaces. Messages flow in normal page flow, composer is fixed to the bottom with a frosted glass dock. Set density (compact/balanced/spacious) to control spacing, message max-width, and blur layer sizing. Includes built-in auto-scroll, a "New messages" scroll-to-bottom button, and a frosted glass blur layer behind the composer. By default the layout root is the scroll container; pass scrollRef to delegate scrolling to a parent element or the document body.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-layout-scroll-button
items.title: Chat Layout Scroll Button
items.description: Floating scroll-to-bottom button that appears when the user scrolls away from the latest messages. It fades in as a compact icon button and expands to show a label when new messages arrive. ChatLayout renders this by default: pass a custom element to the scrollButton prop to override, or null to hide it entirely.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.description: Sender context wrapper: handles avatar, name, metadata, and alignment based on sender role.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-message-bubble
items.title: Chat Message Bubble
items.description: Styled content container for the chat "bubble." Reads sender from parent ChatMessage context to auto-style the background. Use filled for standard messages and ghost when content needs alignment without a visible boundary. Supports name/metadata slots aligned with bubble padding, and multi-bubble grouping via the group prop for consecutive messages from the same sender.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-message-list
items.title: Chat Message List
items.description: Presentational message container with density context and infinite scroll support. Provides role="log" with aria-live="polite" for accessibility. A flex spacer pushes messages to the bottom when the list isn't full; set align="top" to start messages at the top instead.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-message-metadata
items.title: Chat Message Metadata
items.description: Composable metadata row for chat messages. Renders timestamp, footer content, and delivery status in a single row. Direction reverses for user sender. Omits the row when both slots are omitted or non-rendering scalars and status is omitted.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-send-button
items.title: Chat Send Button
items.description: Circular send/stop toggle button for the chat composer. Place it inside ChatComposer where it reads context automatically: no wiring needed. When streaming starts, the button switches from a primary send icon to a secondary stop icon. Override any context value via props for standalone or custom usage.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-system-message
items.title: Chat System Message
items.description: Centered system message for non-sender content like date separators, membership changes, and status notices. It is not a chat bubble; it has no avatar, no alignment, and no sender context. Use the divider variant for temporal breaks and default for inline status updates.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-tokenized-text
items.title: Chat Tokenized Text
items.description: Renders a text string with token patterns replaced by inline token content. Wrap any message body inside ChatMessageBubble to turn raw @mentions, #tags, or /commands into styled content. When no non-empty token matches or none are provided, the text renders as-is, so you can use ChatTokenizedText unconditionally on every message.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-chat-tool-calls
items.title: Chat Tool Calls
items.description: ChatToolCalls displays tool or function call invocations from an LLM response. Pass an array of calls and the component handles the rest: a single call renders inline, while multiple calls collapse into a summary with the latest call visible at the surface. Use it anywhere an AI agent shows what actions it took.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-check-indicator
items.title: Check Indicator
items.description: The mark on a chosen option: a checkmark by default, and nothing at all when unchosen, so a listbox shows no empty box beside every row. This is the indicator to replace to change what "chosen" looks like: mapping it to RadioIndicator gives every single-selection mark radio visuals, including an empty circle on unchosen rows. Unlike the checkbox and radio visuals it renders no chrome of its own (it IS the glyph), so a host's theme target lands on the same element as astryx-icon.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-checkbox-indicator
items.title: Checkbox Indicator
items.description: The checkbox visual: a square box with a checkmark or an indeterminate bar. Decorative (aria-hidden); the owning control keeps the input, role, accessible name, focus, and keyboard behavior.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-checkbox-input
items.title: Checkbox Input
items.description: CheckboxInput toggles a single on/off value. Use it for settings like "Enable notifications", terms acceptance, or opt-in choices. For multiple checkboxes in a group, use CheckboxList instead.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-checkbox-list
items.title: Checkbox List
items.description: Checkbox group container with field integration for label, description, and status.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-checkbox-list-item
items.title: Checkbox List Item
items.description: Individual checkbox item with label, description, and end content slot. Works in collection mode (inside a CheckboxList with a value array) or standalone mode (inside List, or inside a CheckboxList without value, such as a select-all item).
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-citation
items.title: Citation
items.description: Citations display inline references to external sources. Use them to attribute information within AI-generated responses, articles, or anywhere provenance and source links are needed.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-clickable-card
items.title: Clickable Card
items.description: An interactive card for navigation or action targets. Nested interactive elements work independently.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-code
items.title: Code
items.description: Code marks short inline references such as function names, variables, file paths, and command-line flags. Use CodeBlock for standalone or multi-line snippets.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Fenced code block with syntax highlighting. Use for multi-line code snippets.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-collapsible
items.title: Collapsible

items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-collapsible-group
items.title: Collapsible Group
items.description: Coordinates multiple Collapsible instances so only one (single mode) or any number (multiple mode) can be open at a time. Renders no wrapper DOM element unless dividers are enabled.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Root component. Manages open state, search, keyboard navigation, and composition slots.

items.name: component-command-palette-empty
items.title: Command Palette Empty
items.description: Empty state display for the results area. Rendered automatically by CommandPalette for no-results and no-query states.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-command-palette-footer
items.title: Command Palette Footer
items.description: Footer with keyboard guidance. CommandPalette renders the default arrow, Enter, and Escape hints automatically.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-command-palette-group
items.title: Command Palette Group
items.description: Visual grouping with a heading label. Place inside CommandPaletteList.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-command-palette-input
items.title: Command Palette Input
items.description: Search input slot. Auto-focuses on mount. Wires to command palette context when used inside CommandPalette.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-command-palette-item
items.title: Command Palette Item
items.description: One option in a command palette result list. CommandPalette context supplies selection, highlight, identity, and close behavior.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-command-palette-list
items.title: Command Palette List
items.description: Scrollable results container. Renders as a listbox standalone, and inside CommandPalette while selectable results exist. Contains CommandPaletteItem and CommandPaletteGroup children.

items.name: component-complex-selector
items.title: Complex Selector
items.description: An input or toolbar trigger and dialog-popover shell for custom selector content.

items.name: component-context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A context menu that appears on right-click at the cursor position. Wraps trigger content as children.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-context-menu-item
items.title: Context Menu Item
items.description: Menu item component for compound mode. Re-exported from DropdownMenuItem for discoverability.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-date-input
items.title: Date Input
items.description: DateInput lets the user type or pick a date from a calendar popover. Use it for scheduling, deadlines, booking dates, or any form field that needs a specific calendar date.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-date-range-input
items.title: Date Range Input
items.description: DateRangeInput lets users select a start and end date from a dual-month calendar popover. Use it for filtering data by time period, report generation, analytics dashboards, and booking flows.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-date-time-input
items.title: Date Time Input
items.description: DateTimeInput combines date and time selection in one field. With presentation="adaptive-native" (the default), mouse/trackpad devices use Astryx typed fields and popovers, while coarse-pointer devices use browser/OS date and time controls in the same two-segment field. presentation="native" uses both native controls on every pointer; presentation="adaptive-bottom-sheet" keeps Astryx's own surfaces — pointer fields on fine pointers and the coordinated Date/Time bottom sheet on coarse pointers; "popover" and "bottom-sheet" force one Astryx surface on every pointer. The closed segments stay side by side when at least 400px is available and wrap into full-width rows below 400px, independent of viewport width. Use it for scheduling, event creation, deadline setting, or any form field that needs a specific datetime.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog using the native <dialog> element. Modal and inline content starts with theme body text defaults. Ancestor surface/group membership ends as a whole, including group-owned state. Explicit props and unrelated contexts remain unchanged. Place intentional groups and complete required providers inside the dialog.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-dialog-header
items.title: Dialog Header
items.description: Header for dialogs with a title, optional subtitle, close button, and start/end content slots.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: A visual separator that divides content into distinct sections. Use to create clear boundaries between groups of related content, or to demarcate interactive regions within a layout.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description:
A side panel that floats above page content for inspectors and detail views: the "click a table row, see its details" pattern. Unlike a docked panel it overlays the layout instead of reflowing it. Works on desktop and touch: the width budget applies on desktop and the panel preserves a 56px page reveal below 640px without exceeding the width budget. Escape closes the drawer (unless purpose is required) and focus returns to the element that opened it. Entry/exit slide animation respects prefers-reduced-motion. Stacking contract: sibling drawers stack last-opened on top, Escape closes only the topmost, and closing peels innermost-first; render them as siblings, never nested.

Like Dialog, the drawer is a container: its content area is inset by --spacing-4 (16px) by default, by the padding prop, or by a theme's padding on drawer. Compose the header, body, and footer the way Dialog does, with a Layout: DrawerHeader in the header slot (it shows a close button when you pass it onOpenChange, like DialogHeader), the body in LayoutContent, and actions in LayoutFooter. The Layout redistributes the inset to those regions so they line up on one content line, and the header is not inset twice. A lone Section child also escapes the inset. Drawer renders no close button of its own, so give every drawer a visible way to close, especially a non-modal one, which has no scrim to click. Put data-autofocus on the control that should receive focus on open.

Choosing a surface: use Dialog for a centered decision or short form, Drawer for full-height side detail that keeps the page in sight, BottomSheet for block-axis sheets on touch, and a docked panel (a layout column) when content should reflow the page instead of floating over it.

Theming: the panel is the single stable target (astryx-drawer, with data-side reflecting side), and the scrim is the panel's native ::backdrop. DrawerHeader exposes astryx-drawer-header targets for its row, slots, and close icon.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-drawer-header
items.title: Drawer Header
items.description: Header for drawers with a title, optional subtitle, close button, and start/end content slots. Same API as DialogHeader.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Action menu with a trigger button and anchored, bottom-sheet, or adaptive presentation.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-dropdown-menu-checkbox-item
items.title: Dropdown Menu Checkbox Item
items.description: A checkable menu item (role="menuitemcheckbox") that toggles an independent boolean. Use for on/off options inside a DropdownMenu; for a one-of-N choice use DropdownMenuRadioGroup.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-dropdown-menu-divider
items.title: Dropdown Menu Divider
items.description: A horizontal rule separating groups of rows in a compound menu. Renders role="separator", so it is never a stop in the arrow-key order. The data-driven equivalent is the `{type: "divider"}` entry in `items`; both modes render this component, so they look and theme identically. Host attributes and DOM handlers (id, data-*, aria-*) reach the separator; its role and orientation stay component-owned.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-dropdown-menu-group
items.title: Dropdown Menu Group
items.description: A group of rows in a compound menu. A visible title names role="group" through aria-labelledby; an omitted title leaves the group unnamed. The heading is not a menuitem, so arrow keys and typeahead skip it. Keep title content non-interactive and place controls in DropdownMenu header or footer. The data-driven equivalent is the `{type: "section", title, items}` entry in `items`; both forms share the heading treatment and theme target.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-dropdown-menu-item
items.title: Dropdown Menu Item
items.description: One action or destination row in the pointer presentation of DropdownMenu. The parent menu owns keyboard navigation; the row owns activation, disabled state, destination behavior, content layout, and its theme target. Supported host attributes, DOM handlers, className, style, xstyle, and ref reach or compose on the role="menuitem" root.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-dropdown-menu-radio-group
items.title: Dropdown Menu Radio Group
items.description: A controlled, named single-select group of DropdownMenuRadioItem children (role="group" of menuitemradio). Owns value propagation, close policy, root composition, and the menu inter-item gap; the parent DropdownMenu owns keyboard navigation.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-dropdown-menu-radio-item
items.title: Dropdown Menu Radio Item
items.description: A single option in a DropdownMenuRadioGroup (role="menuitemradio"). Must be used inside a DropdownMenuRadioGroup.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-dropdown-menu-sub-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu Submenu
items.description: A single menu row that reveals a nested flyout of its own items. The row adopts DropdownMenuItem semantics (label / icon / description / isDisabled); its children become the flyout content. Opens inline-end with viewport auto-flip; Right/Enter/Space opens and focuses the first item, Left/Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger (Right/Left swap in RTL). On a phone (a coarse pointer, decided when the menu opened) the row drills in instead: its rows replace the menu's rows in the same box, led by a Back row named "Back to <parent>", and Back, Escape or ArrowLeft return to the row. Host attributes and DOM event handlers (aria-*, data-*, id) reach the trigger row, the element carrying role="menuitem" and aria-haspopup="menu"; a caller's handlers run after the row's own, except for the keys that open the flyout (the open arrow, Enter, Space) and a click on a disabled row. For data-driven menus, give a menu item a nested `items` array instead of using this component directly.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: EmptyState shows a placeholder when a content area has no data. Use it for empty lists, zero search results, first-time setups, or cleared inboxes. Always include a title and a next step so the user is not stuck.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-field
items.title: Field
items.description: Low-level form field wrapper for custom controls that need a label, description, and optional/required indicators.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-field-label
items.title: Field Label
items.description: Standalone label group for one control or a caller-labelled group, with optional supporting text, optionality indicators, icon, and tooltip.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-field-status
items.title: Field Status
items.description: FieldStatus renders validation feedback for fields and field-like controls. Use it directly for custom controls that need the same error, warning, or success presentation as Field.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-file-input
items.title: File Input
items.description: FileInput provides file upload with optional drag-and-drop support. Use it for single or multiple file selection with built-in validation for file type, size, and count. Pair with validation status for upload feedback.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-form-layout
items.title: Form Layout
items.description: A layout container that arranges form fields with consistent spacing and direction. FormLayout handles where fields go, not state or submission. Wrap it in a <form> for that. Supports vertical (default), horizontal, and horizontal-labels directions, and can be nested to mix them.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: Grid container with fixed or responsive columns; `{minWidth, max}` reflows, a number never does.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-grid-span
items.title: Grid Span
items.description: Grid item that spans multiple columns or rows.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-h-stack
items.title: H Stack
items.description: Horizontal stack for arranging items left-to-right. Supports polymorphic rendering.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: Semantic heading component that renders h1-h6 elements with themed styling, themed sizing via type scale tokens, and line-clamp truncation.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Component wrapper for hover card display: a richer, larger overlay triggered on hover or focus.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Icons are small visual symbols that represent actions, objects, or concepts. They improve scannability and reinforce meaning alongside text. Supports both direct SVG components and semantic icon names that adapt to the active theme.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: A button that shows only an icon with no visible text. Use IconButton in toolbars, table rows, and compact UI where space is tight and the icon is universally understood.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Groups an input with prefix/suffix addons in a visually connected container with shared border and focus ring.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-input-group-text
items.title: Input Group Text
items.description: A prefix or suffix text element rendered inside InputGroup. Displays text or icons.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-internationalization-provider
items.title: Internationalization Provider
items.description: Wraps your app to set the active locale and (optionally) merge additional translation catalogs + per-locale overrides. Astryx components inside the subtree resolve their strings against this context. If no provider is present, components fall back to the shipped English defaults.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-item
items.title: Item
items.description: A universal item primitive that unifies the "start content + label + description + end content" layout pattern. Use as a building block for list items, menu items, contact rows, notifications, and more.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Renders a keyboard shortcut as styled key badges. Use Kbd in tooltips, menus, and help text to show key combinations.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-layer-provider
items.title: Layer Provider
items.description: App-level provider for layer systems such as toast viewports and imperative modals. Nested providers pass through.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-layout
items.title: Layout
items.description: General five-slot layout primitive for arranging header, start, content, end, and footer regions.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-layout-content
items.title: Layout Content
items.description: Scrollable main content area.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-layout-footer
items.title: Layout Footer
items.description: Bottom bar for action bars, pagination, and status bars.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-layout-header
items.title: Layout Header
items.description: Top bar for page titles, app bars, and toolbars.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-layout-panel
items.title: Layout Panel
items.description: Sidebar for navigation, settings, or inspector panels.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: A fullscreen overlay for viewing images and videos at full resolution. Supports single-item and gallery modes with prev/next navigation, optional zoom and pan for images, and native video controls.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-link
items.title: Link
items.description: Styled anchor link with variants, external link support, and polymorphic rendering.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-link-provider
items.title: Link Provider
items.description: Wraps your app to replace the default <a> tag with a framework-specific link component (e.g. Next.js Link) for client-side routing across all Astryx components.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-list
items.title: List
items.description: List container with density, dividers, and header support.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-list-item
items.title: List Item
items.description: List item with label, description, start/end content slots, and interactive patterns.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-markdown
items.title: Markdown
items.description: Renders a markdown string as Astryx-styled components. Use Markdown for user-generated content, AI responses, and documentation; it handles headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and citations with consistent styling.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-media-theme
items.title: Media Theme
items.description: Provides token overrides for content rendered on inverted surfaces: media overlays, scrims, toasts, and tooltips. The base behavior flips color-scheme so all light-dark() tokens resolve to the correct side. Only a small set of tokens need explicit overrides beyond that. Themes can further customize component appearance on media surfaces via onDark/onLight in defineTheme(), with both token overrides (e.g. "--color-accent": "#90CAF9") and component overrides (e.g. ghost buttons get a border on dark surfaces).
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-metadata-list
items.title: Metadata List
items.description: Container for metadata items with column layout, orientation, and collapse support.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-metadata-list-item
items.title: Metadata List Item
items.description: A single labeled metadata value within an MetadataList.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-mobile-nav
items.title: Mobile Nav
items.description: A slide-out drawer for mobile navigation. Accepts SideNav children.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-mobile-nav-toggle
items.title: Mobile Nav Toggle
items.description: Hamburger button that opens/closes the mobile nav drawer. Reads open state from AppShell context automatically: does NOT accept isOpen or onOpenChange props. Renders nothing above the mobile breakpoint.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-more-menu
items.title: More Menu
items.description: MoreMenu is a three-dot button that opens a list of actions. Use it for secondary actions that don't need to be always visible, like in table rows, card headers, or toolbars.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-multi-selector
items.title: Multi Selector
items.description: Multi-select dropdown with checkboxes for choosing multiple items.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-nav-heading-menu
items.title: Nav Heading Menu
items.description: Accessible menu container and items for nav heading popovers. NavHeadingMenu provides role="menu" with keyboard navigation; NavHeadingMenuItem renders individual selectable items. Pass as the menu prop of SideNavHeading or TopNavHeading.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-nav-icon
items.title: Nav Icon
items.description: NavIcon is a circular icon container with an accent-colored background. Use it in navigation headers such as TopNavHeading and PageNavHeader to visually identify a section or application.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: A form input for numeric values with built-in validation, min/max constraints, and step controls. Use NumberInput for quantities, measurements, percentages, and similar inputs.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-outline
items.title: Outline
items.description: Document outline navigation with sliding indicator track. Renders a flat heading list as anchor links with a density variant and scroll-spy active state when uncontrolled.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-overflow-list
items.title: Overflow List
items.description: A horizontal list that automatically hides items when they exceed the available width. Use OverflowList for breadcrumbs, toolbars, tag lists, or any row that needs to collapse gracefully at smaller sizes.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-overlay
items.title: Overlay
items.description: Overlay layers action or supporting content over media, cards, video, or other bounded surfaces with an optional scrim and reveal behavior.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination lets users step through pages of content. Place it below a table, list, or card grid so users can move forward and backward through results. Pick a variant to match the context: numbered pages for data tables, a count for large lists, compact for tight spaces, or dots for carousels.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A click-triggered popover for displaying interactive content anchored to a trigger element.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-power-search
items.title: Power Search
items.description: PowerSearch is a structured filter bar where each token represents a field, operator, and value. Use it for complex multi-dimensional filtering when users need to combine multiple search criteria. For simple single-field search, use a text input instead.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: A horizontal bar showing the completion progress of a task. Use it for operations where the duration is known, or as an animated indicator when progress can't be calculated. Supports semantic color variants, value labels, and custom formatting.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-radio-indicator
items.title: Radio Indicator
items.description: The radio visual: a circle with a filled inner dot when selected. Draws in both states; an unselected radio is an empty circle, which is what lets it stand in for a checkmark in a selection slot.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-radio-list
items.title: Radio List
items.description: Radio group container with field integration for label, description, and status.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-radio-list-item
items.title: Radio List Item

items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-resize-handle
items.title: Resize Handle
items.description: Draggable separator between panels. Pill-grip design: invisible at rest, visible on hover (0.6 opacity), fully opaque during drag (1.0). Keyboard-accessible.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-richtext-rich-text-editor
items.title: Rich Text Editor
items.description: A WYSIWYG rich-text editor built on Lexical, styled with Astryx design tokens. Its field container shares TextArea input visuals for the resting border, hover ring, focus-within ring, disabled state, and status colors. Ships from @astryxdesign/richtext; lexical and @lexical/* are optional peer dependencies. The editor is deliberately minimal and extensible: pass toolbar, nodes, and plugins to layer richer behaviour (formatting, mentions, hover cards) on top without forking. Use RichTextView to render serialized content read-only.

items.title: Scrollable Area
items.description: Provides a native scroll viewport and a real observed content box. The viewport enters the tab order only while a requested logical axis is effectively scrollable, and containment applies only to effective axes.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-section
items.title: Section

Use it for settings groups, form sections, sidebar areas, or any time you need visual separation between parts of a page. If you are tempted to use a Card for a page section, use Section instead.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Container wrapper providing context (value, onChange, size, isDisabled) to SegmentedControlItem children.

items.name: component-selectable-card

items.title: Side Nav Section

items.name: component-skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: An animated shimmer placeholder that previews the shape of content while it loads. Use it to build loading screens that match the layout of the real content. For content with unknown dimensions, use Spinner instead.

items.name: component-slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A draggable control for selecting a numeric value or range within defined bounds. Supports single value and range selection, tick marks, custom value formatting, and vertical orientation. Use it when users need to explore a continuous range, such as volume, price, or percentage.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An animated loading indicator for processes with unknown duration, such as data fetching or form submission. Supports visible labels, multiple sizes, and a dark background variant. For content with known dimensions, use Skeleton instead.

items.name: component-stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: Unified stack layout component with a direction prop. Use direction="horizontal" for left-to-right flow or direction="vertical" (default) for top-to-bottom. For convenience, HStack and VStack are pre-configured wrappers.
items.author: Astryx

items.description: Stack item for controlling individual item behavior within a stack. Supports polymorphic rendering.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-status-dot
items.title: Status Dot
items.description: A small colored dot that communicates status like online/offline presence or severity levels. Supports five semantic variants and an optional pulse animation. Always pair with a visible text label, as color alone should not carry meaning.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-step
items.title: Step
items.description: Individual step within a Stepper. Renders a progress-bar segment, an indicator, and a label with optional description. Progress (completed/active/not-started) is derived from the parent Stepper's activeStep and this step's step index.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Container component that manages step state and renders steps in horizontal or vertical orientation as an ordered list.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A toggle control for on/off states that take effect immediately. Supports labels, descriptions, loading states, and validation. Use it for settings or preferences that apply instantly. For changes requiring a form submission, use a checkbox instead.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-syntax-theme
items.title: Syntax Theme
items.description: Applies syntax highlighting colors to CodeBlock and any code component in the subtree. By default, code components use the theme-level syntax colors (set via defineTheme({ syntax: ... })), which derive from the palette (--color-text-accent for keywords, --color-text-green for strings, etc.). SyntaxTheme lets you override those per-region. The system uses 14 semantic tokens (keyword, string, comment, number, function, type, variable, operator, constant, tag, attribute, property, punctuation, background) validated against 11 community themes. Custom themes are created with defineSyntaxTheme() and can use [light, dark] tuples for automatic color-scheme adaptation. Built-in presets: oneDarkPro, dracula, monokai, nord, tokyoNight, catppuccinMocha, githubLight, githubDark, solarizedLight, oneLight (import from @astryxdesign/core/theme/syntax).

items.name: component-tab-menu
items.title: Tab Menu
items.description: Overflow menu trigger that opens a dropdown of additional tab options, showing the selected option's label as the trigger text. Host attributes and DOM event handlers (id, aria-*, data-*, drag and drop) reach the trigger button, not the popup or its options. The button keeps its role, tab stop, and menu disclosure attributes.

items.name: component-table
items.title: Table
items.description: Styled, data-driven table with density, dividers, hover highlight, striped rows, and named plugin support. T must extend Record<string, unknown>.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-table-body
items.title: Table Body
items.description: <tbody> wrapper for children mode. Holds the data rows. A row must sit inside a section: <table> cannot contain a <tr> directly, because the HTML parser inserts an implied <tbody> when it parses server-rendered markup and React does not when it renders on the client, so rows written straight into Table mismatch on hydration. The data-driven data={...} mode renders this element itself; in children mode it is yours to supply.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-table-cell
items.title: Table Cell
items.description: <td> wrapper that reads TableContext to apply density padding, font size, and divider borders when used inside Table.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-table-footer
items.title: Table Footer
items.description: <tfoot> wrapper for children mode. Holds summary or total rows beneath the body. A row must sit inside a section: <table> cannot contain a <tr> directly, because the HTML parser inserts an implied <tbody> when it parses server-rendered markup and React does not when it renders on the client, so the two trees mismatch on hydration. Children mode only: the data-driven data={...} path renders a header and a body, never a footer.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-table-header
items.title: Table Header
items.description: <thead> wrapper for children mode. Holds the header row, whose cells are TableHeaderCell. A row must sit inside a section: <table> cannot contain a <tr> directly, because the HTML parser inserts an implied <tbody> when it parses server-rendered markup and React does not when it renders on the client, so the two trees mismatch on hydration. The data-driven data={...} mode renders this element itself whenever columns are supplied; in children mode it is yours to supply.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-table-header-cell
items.title: Table Header Cell
items.description: <th> wrapper that reads TableContext to apply density padding, semibold weight, secondary text color, and divider borders when used inside Table.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-table-row
items.title: Table Row
items.description: <tr> wrapper that reads TableContext to apply striped, hover, and divider styles when used inside Table.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-table-selection-toolbar
items.title: Table Selection Toolbar
items.description: Selection-aware bulk-action surface built on Toolbar. Pass selectionState from useTableSelectionState so count, visibility, and complete clearing stay synchronized with the Table selection plugin. The component owns no table or sticky layout: place it in flow or apply caller-owned positioning through xstyle.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-text
items.title: Text
items.description: Semantic body text component that renders text with type-based styling from the theme, with optional truncation, decoration, and layout props.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-text-area
items.title: Text Area
items.description: TextArea is a multi-line text input for collecting longer-form content like comments, descriptions, or messages. Use it when the expected input spans multiple lines. For shorter, single-line values, use TextInput.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-text-input
items.title: Text Input
items.description: TextInput collects short-form text like names, emails, or search queries. Use it for single-line values where the expected input is brief. Pair it with validation status to guide users through required or formatted fields.

items.name: component-theme

items.name: component-thumbnail

Use it in chat composers, file upload lists, or anywhere you need a small image preview with optional remove and click actions.

items.name: component-time-input
items.title: Time Input
items.description: TimeInput uses a browser/OS time picker on coarse pointers by default and Astryx's typed field on fine pointers. It converts values to a standard format and supports arrow-key adjustment on the typed surface. Use it in forms, scheduling flows, or any interface where users need to select a specific time.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-timer
items.title: Timer
items.description: Displays a standardized elapsed duration for active work without scheduling a React render on every tick. Elapsed format updates by second below one hour and by minute after one hour; clock format remains second-precise.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-timestamp
items.title: Timestamp
items.description: Timestamp formats a date or time value into human-readable text. Use it to show when something was created, updated, or is scheduled; picking relative for recency, absolute for precision, or auto to let the component decide.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-toast
items.title: Toast
items.description:
Toast shows a brief, non-blocking notification to confirm an action or present temporary information. Use it for scenarios where the user needs feedback but not a decision, such as saving, deleting, or changing a status.

For production use, prefer the `useToast()` hook; it handles positioning, stacking, auto-dismiss, and deduplication via `ToastViewport`. Toasts stay within viewport and safe-area gutters, wrap long message content, and enter, exit, or swipe-dismiss toward their configured top or bottom edge. The vertical swipe uses the same spatial model as placement motion: top Toasts leave upward and bottom Toasts leave downward. Swipe waits for dominant edge-directed intent before cancelling native touch movement and reports the existing manual dismissal reason. Pen is supported as direct-contact input; mouse drag is excluded to avoid conflicting with desktop text selection, where the visible close control remains available. Set `isAutoHide: false` explicitly when an action or message must remain available. The `Toast` component renders the visual toast element inline and is useful for previews, documentation, and static showcases where the viewport lifecycle is not needed.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-toggle-button
items.title: Toggle Button
items.description: A button that toggles between pressed and unpressed states. Thin wrapper over Button with controlled toggle pattern, icon swap, and font weight emphasis.

items.name: component-toggle-button-group

items.name: component-tokenizer

items.name: component-top-nav-heading

items.description: Product/suite/account heading for the TopNav heading slot. Supports smart interaction boundary logic: logo, heading text, superheading/subheading with independent links, and an optional menu popover with automatic chevron indicator.

items.name: component-top-nav-item
items.title: Top Nav Item

items.name: component-top-nav-mega-menu
items.title: Top Nav Mega Menu
items.description: Navigation item that displays a full-width mega menu panel on hover. Uses a slots API with items and featured props. TopNavMegaMenuItem renders itself in both desktop and mobile drawer modes. Supports inline collapsible drawer via render mode context.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: component-top-nav-mega-menu-featured-card
items.title: Top Nav Mega Menu Featured Card
items.description: Standard featured card for the TopNavMegaMenu featured slot. Provides a consistent card with optional image, title, description, and CTA link.
